items.html: *Now, when you count the name from AB, every discernment of AB will be the Yod of HaVaYaH, and SAG the first Hey of HaVaYaH, and MA the letter Vav, and BON the last Hey. And when we count the name from the discernment of SAG alone, the Taamim of SAG will be the letter Yod, and the Nekudot the first Hey, and the tagin the letter Vav, and the letters the last Hey. And when we further divide the Taamim, the letter Yod will be in the Ozen, and the first Hey in the Hotem, and the letter Vav in the Peh, and the last Hey in the Einayim. Thus the eye has the discernment of the last Hey and of the first Hey.
